generate_context_embeddings: run GenerateEmbeddingsTask to encode contexts and save embeddings as pickle files per GPU rank
generate_query_embeddings: run GenerateQueryEmbeddingsTask to encode queries and save query representations to a pickle file
review_GenerateEmbeddingsTask_forward: review the GenerateEmbeddingsTask forward method to understand how contexts are encoded via encode_contexts
review_GenerateQueryEmbeddingsTask_forwa: review the GenerateQueryEmbeddingsTask forward method to understand how queries are encoded via encode_queries
test_GenerateEmbeddingsTask_test_epoch_e: test the GenerateEmbeddingsTask test_epoch_end method to verify embeddings are saved correctly per rank
